system.prerequisites: Level 10, any Eternal Blood Heritage feat, Lightwoven or Seraphel
system.description:
The power within your ancestry is no longer a faint inheritance. The outer planes recognize something of themselves in you.
You gain a +1-racial bonus to attack rolls and Save DCs generated by innate spells gained from your Eternal Blood Heritage.
You also gain Eternal Lore as a specialist skill. If you already possess Eternal Lore, you instead gain a +2-racial bonus to Recall Knowledge checks made using it.

Prerequisites Level 10, any Eternal Blood Heritage feat, Lightwoven or Seraphel

Works automatically: Eternal Lore is added to your specialist skills (if you already had it, the +2 to Recall Knowledge with it is a note); every innate spell you cast, an item's included, carries +1 racial to its attack roll and Save DC (TRG Prime 3.695.0's declared spell bonuses).

effects.description: +1 racial to the attack roll and Save DC of every innate spell you cast.
